name: research_handoff
description: Mid-task handoff: competitive analysis for a prediction markets startup, 3 of 5 competitors analyzed

conversation.content: Do a competitive analysis for Keep — biometric prediction markets. Compare vs Beeminder, Metaculus, Manifold Markets, PredictIt, and Augur.
Starting with Beeminder since you mentioned it as the primary comp. Then I'll work through the others.

Beeminder: commitment contracts with money on the line. $0 stakes initially, user sets their own amount. Strong on personal goals, weak on social/market dynamics. No biometric integration. B2C, $0-$270/year tiers. Key insight: they have 10 years of data on what commitment mechanisms work. Differentiator vs Keep: Keep uses external oracle (Whoop API), Beeminder relies on self-reported data — massive integrity gap.

Metaculus: forecasting tournament platform. Points-based, no real money (US regulatory arbitrage). Strong at geopolitical/scientific questions. Audience: superforecasters, researchers. Not a competitor for Keep's core loop — different customer entirely. Relevant only if Keep eventually does public markets on aggregate biometric trends.

Manifold: play-money prediction markets on anything. Mana (in-game currency) only. Creative, community-driven, lots of personal/culture questions. Their resolution mechanism is manual (creator resolves) — this is Keep's key advantage: oracle-based auto-resolution is trustless and scalable. Manifold's TAM is engagement-driven entertainment; Keep's is behavior change with financial stakes.

tool_history.output: Beeminder: freemium, paid tiers $0-$270/yr, ~$1M ARR estimated, 50k users
Metaculus: nonprofit-ish, $6M seed 2022, 30k forecasters, no real money
Manifold: ~100k users, no revenue (play money only), Y Combinator W22
